response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional software development skills and strong technical versatility, he lacks the demonstrated team leadership, enterprise IT architecture, security/compliance expertise, and German language proficiency (C1 required vs. Basic) required for this executive Head of Development role. He is better positioned for a senior developer or staff engineer position rather than executive-level consulting and team leadership responsibilities.
strengths: Extensive modern software development expertise across TypeScript, Node.js, D Lang, and multiple platforms with proven ability to deliver complex systems at scale
Strong passion for open-source technologies with proven track record building and maintaining GISCollective platform serving NGOs and conservation organizations
Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn new domains and technologies across diverse technical stacks, languages, and problem spaces
concerns: German language proficiency listed as only 'Basic' while role explicitly requires minimum C1 competency—critical gap for Berlin-based consulting position
Limited demonstrated experience in team leadership, mentoring, or executive-level responsibility despite senior-level titles—role requires leading interdisciplinary teams
No evidence of IT security expertise, risk management, compliance knowledge, or formal IT architecture methodologies (UML, requirements management) essential for advisory consulting role
